name: Charm Academy
source:
You're the new student, and homecoming is tonight! Can you find a date before the end of the day? 

A short otome visual novel with an abundance of wacky choices and six classmates to befriend (and even perhaps maybe flirt with!!?!?) Go through the school day and find your perfect homecoming date! Voted most hardcore epic coolest game of the year and has won several awards,* this cute and fluffy game is perfect for silly lil' gooses.

[From [url=https://vanillailla.itch.io/charm-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
